sentences.en: Besides being a doctor, he was a very famous novelist.
sentences.zh: 除了是医生之外，他还是一位非常著名的 novelist。

sentences.en: I don't want to go, and besides it's too late.
sentences.zh: 我不想去，而且现在已经太晚了。

sentences.en: There are plenty more fish in the sea besides him.
sentences.zh: 海里还有很多其他的鱼，不只是他。
